actions.name: nollm.validate
actions.description: Validate a filesystem notebook against Nollm invariants.
actions.returns: Validation pass flag and issue list.

actions.name: nollm.audit
actions.description: Return a deterministic derived audit report. Audit is read-only, derived, not memory, not a recall index, not source of truth, and does not append ledger events.
actions.returns: Audit sections for validation, notebook, cards, honeycomb, anchor_fields, recall_digests, ledger, and boundaries. Audit does not use SQLite and does not perform geometry recall, polygon overlap, automatic placement, or semantic completeness scoring.

actions.name: nollm.inspect
actions.description: Return a deterministic read-only active inspection surface for cards matching metadata filters. Inspect is metadata-derived, not a passive operator queue, not approval, not truth assessment, not semantic scoring, and not memory recall.
actions.returns: Inspection filters, review_count, annotation_count per returned card, and compact card metadata. Inspect does not include full card bodies or annotation text by default, does not change status, does not append ledger events, does not create an approval gate, and does not use SQLite, embeddings, vector search, graph search, geometry recall, or external LLM operations.

actions.name: nollm.review
actions.description: Compatibility alias for nollm.inspect. Review remains a deterministic read-only active inspection surface for cards matching metadata filters. Review is metadata-derived, not a passive operator queue, not approval, not truth assessment, not semantic scoring, and not memory recall.
actions.returns: Review filters, review_count, annotation_count per returned card, and compact card metadata. Review does not include full card bodies or annotation text by default, does not change status, does not append ledger events, does not create an approval gate, and does not use SQLite, embeddings, vector search, graph search, geometry recall, or external LLM operations.

actions.name: nollm.annotate
actions.description: Append an operator annotation ledger event to a card. Annotations are operator notes, not card content, not approval, not truth assessment, not trust changes, not semantic scoring, not passive review, and not memory recall.
actions.returns: Annotation event id, ledger address, target card id, and annotation_type. Annotate does not modify card content, status, trust, or body.

actions.name: nollm.annotations
actions.description: List append-only annotation ledger events for one card. Annotation listing is metadata inspection only and does not approve memory, prove truth, block LLM usage, change trust, change status, or perform semantic scoring.
actions.returns: Compact annotation ledger event metadata without card bodies. Annotation counts are not semantic risk scores.

actions.name: nollm.orient
actions.description: Orient a query to candidate anchors.
actions.returns: Memory intent, candidate anchors, matched anchors, and warnings.

actions.name: nollm.surface
actions.description: Return a finite surface for one anchor.
actions.returns: Anchor metadata, active card counts, and top card summaries.

actions.name: nollm.focus
actions.description: Return focused card front matter and claims.

actions.name: nollm.recall
actions.description: Run deterministic orient-surface-focus recall and write digest files. The digest includes active_anchor_fields, scale_path, lateral_recovery, and sufficient_scale_reached as scale-scan metadata.
actions.returns: Recall digest plus JSON and Markdown digest paths. scale_path is metadata-only; Core does not perform geometry-based recall, calculate polygon overlap, or infer semantic completeness.

actions.name: nollm.write_card
actions.description: Write a draft or candidate card and append a creation ledger event.
actions.returns: Card id, card address, ledger event id, and file path.

actions.name: nollm.read_card
actions.description: Read exactly one explicit card by id or memory address. read_card is not recall, not context composition, does not return neighbors, does not rank related cards, and does not change status or trust.
actions.returns: Requested card id, address, optional frontmatter, and optional body. No neighboring cards, related cards, semantic matches, recommendations, or context bundles are returned.

actions.name: nollm.update_status
actions.description: Update card status and append a ledger event.
actions.returns: Updated card id, status transition, and ledger event id.

actions.name: nollm.ledger
actions.description: Return filtered ledger audit trail events. Ledger is an audit trail, not memory recall, not truth assessment, not approval, not semantic scoring, and does not change status or trust.
actions.returns: Filtered compact ledger events without card bodies.

actions.name: nollm.history
actions.description: Return object-level ledger inspection for one card. History is audit trail inspection, not memory recall, not truth assessment, not approval, not semantic scoring, and does not change status or trust.
actions.returns: Compact ledger events for one object. Annotation text may appear in history because history is explicit audit inspection, but annotation text is still not recall content.
